method.template_candidates: first three candidates from exact reconstructed V3 TBM Raw bank
method.pretrained_candidates: first two direct DRfold2 cfg_97 candidates ranked by mean pLDDT
method.fallback: when fewer than two direct DRfold2 candidates are available, fill missing slots with the next ranked V3 template candidates; never drop a target
method.self_exclusion: exclude all native/reference PDB IDs listed for the target
method.tbm_retrieval: MMseqs2 over the full snapshot plus exhaustive historical 0.4 global + 0.3 local + 0.2 RNA-feature + 0.1 3-mer composite search over the 7,155-sequence derived view
method.tbm_ranking: identity x query coverage x template completeness, stable tie order, distinct-PDB-first
method.long_target_behavior: DRfold2 unavailable for R1138 (720 nt) in the frozen candidate cache; realized bank is 5T through the recorded fallback

kaggle_status_at_freeze.independence_limitation: The downloaded Kaggle test_sequences.csv is byte-identical to validation_sequences.csv used for CASP15 development. A late leaderboard result is an official-scorer/deployment compatibility check, not an independent hidden-target evaluation.

post_freeze_rule: Do not change candidate generation, allocation, ordering, fallback, or refinement after observing the Kaggle score. Any technical rerun must retain this method and be documented.
